responsibility: Declares the root support library’s minimal pointer-keyed associative-array API. It defines opaque `AA` storage plus `Key`/`Value` pointer typedefs and exposes the lookup, insertion, length, rvalue access, and rehash routines used by front-end data structures such as symbol tables and memoization maps.
same_name_distinction: Provides the opaque AA declaration, Key/Value typedefs, and public associative-array function prototypes; unlike aav.c, it does not define the internal node/table structures or hashing and rehash implementation.
